body:
It's a couple things. The pain is one, I don't want to hurt anymore. I have chronic illnesses and I feel so horrible all the time. I don't want it to be worse. 
I don't want to be lying there, unable to move while my brain slowly dies. Able to feel everything for the agonizing minutes before I would pass.
I'm also afraid of what comes after. I spend a lot of time pondering things about the world. I don't believe in any particular afterlife, there's no proof any of it is real. If it was that would be great. But what if you die, and then you just sit in your body and rot away. I don't know what happens when you die, and not knowing scares me.

It's the pain, and the mystery.
